themes.title: Trump Waives Russia Sanctions
themes.blurb: President Trump's decision to temporarily waive sanctions on Russia's energy sector to facilitate peace negotiations and lower domestic fuel costs continues to generate significant cross-border fallout. While Trump defends the relief as essential leverage for peace while accusing Ukrainian leadership of prolonging the war, foreign media and international observers frame the move as a major concession to Moscow.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration defends energy sanctions relief as a pragmatic measure to lower domestic fuel costs for farmers and force peace talks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French and international coverage focuses on Zelensky's denunciation of the US policy shift and its impact on European security.
